ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If needed, Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.

CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.

Adoption of Ordinance No. 2021-02, which amends Chapter 30.41 Affordable Housing of the Encinitas Municipal Code and the Local Coastal Plan. The Ordinance amends the inclusionary housing regulations to increase the inclusionary housing percentage requirements to better address the need for affordable units for all residential development. Contact Person: Planning Manager Gates

Contact Person: Housing Services Manager Gutierrez
1) Adopt Ordinance No. 2021-09 titled “Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Establishing Reasonable Local Standards and Procedures for Operation of a Safe Parking Lot in Accordance with Government Code Section 8698 (Shelter Crisis)” (Attachment 1 of the agenda report); 2) Adopt Resolution No. 2021-89 “Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Confirming the Existence of a Shelter Crisis and Taking Actions to Approve the Establishment of a Safe Parking Program” (Attachment 2 of the agenda report); and 3) Approve the Use Agreement between City of Encinitas and Jewish Family Services, as attached in substantial form, subject to review and final approval by City Attorney, for the purpose of operating a Safe Parking Program, and authorize the City Manager to execute the agreement (Attachment 3 of the agenda report).

Amendment #2 to the Design Services Agreement for the 2019-2020 Annual Citywide Sewer and Sewer Manhole Rehabilitation/Replacement Program with Dudek for Additional Design and Permitting Services (CE04H and CC04E). Contact Person: Associate Engineer Ballesteros
Authorize the City Manager or designee, in consultation with the City Attorney, to execute Amendment #2, in substantial form as included in Attachment 1 of the agenda report, to the Dudek FY 2019-2020 Annual Citywide Sewer and Sewer Manhole Rehabilitation/Replacement Program Design Services Agreement. This amendment will add $180,740 plus 20 percent contingency of $36,148 for a project total of $216,888 for additional design and permitting services. If approved, the new total not-to-exceed amount for the agreement will be $618,056. Amendment #2 will also provide additional contract time to complete additional tasks by extending the term of the contract to December 31, 2024.

Public Hearing to consider two timely-filed appeals of the Planning Commission's denial of a Design Review Permit, Density Bonus and Coastal Development Permit for the demolition of existing single-family homes and accessory structures, consolidation of four legal lots into one, and construction of a 277-unit apartment development (236 market-rate and 41 low-income affordable units), including a leasing and amenity space, private outdoor recreation space, signage, grading and landscaping improvements. Contact Person: Planning Manager Colamussi
CASE NUMBER: MULTI-003587-2020, DR-003589-2020 & BADJ-003588-2020; APPLICANT: Encinitas Boulevard Apartments 6.95, LP, Randy Goodson; APPELLANT #1: Randy Goodson; APPELLANT #2: Encinitas Residents for Responsible Development, Daniel Vaughn; LOCATION: 2220, 2228 & 2230 Encinitas Boulevard (APNs: 259-231-28, 30, 31 & 32).
Recommended Action: Deny both appeals but modify the decision of the Planning Commission and adopt attached draft City Council Resolutions Nos. 2021-93 and 2021-95 (Attachment 1 of the agenda report) to deny the Density Bonus, Design Review Permit and Coastal Development Permit, and approve the Boundary Line Adjustment.

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
